title: BINAH Reality Gate Request
description: Request contract for validating whether a business need passes the BINAH Reality Gate.

evidence.description: Evidence supporting the existence and relevance of the need.

consequences.description: Relevant consequences produced by the current situation.

exists.description: Whether the need or underlying situation currently exists.

wants_to_solve.description: Whether the business explicitly wants to solve the need.

capability_insufficient.description: Whether current capability is insufficient relative to the required capability.
